Preserve that skater's clothing, board, action and the established sunny detailed graphic-novel/screenprinted aesthetic, vivid blue sky, palms, turquoise lagoon and cream skatepark concrete. Output a single full-bleed portrait scene, NOT a sheet or a finished card. Remove all printed text, card title, badges, numbers, frames, cream card borders, white graphic motion arrows and decorative card waves. Complete the sky and ground naturally where the printed layout used to be. Keep the entire skater AND board visible, anatomically credible, with a single deck, two trucks and exactly FOUR physical wheels (only those visible in perspective need be shown). Opaque illustrated background. Specific target: HEELFLIP, lower-left illustration of the woman in black tank top and pale blue jeans, loose dark hair, colorful purple skateboard flipping below her feet. Keep her entire head, outstretched arms, bent legs and flipping board comfortably inside the frame.
